days.title: Foundation day — deploy skeleton lands
days.body:
Kicked off the Octivate deploy tree for Future Caribbean Open Track (team Shemuel / CENSII). Unpacked the Next.js app shell, mapped routes for landing + auth + workspace, and confirmed the server could boot on this Windows host. Early friction: PowerShell vs bash habits and path quirks — solved by standardizing on PowerShell `;` chains and absolute paths. The machine (Cursor agent) and I agreed: ship a runnable deploy first, polish later. Outcome: project root alive, README orientation, first mental model of Power–Systems–Narratives (PSN).

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Mon_07_13.png

days.title: Auth + brand geometry
days.body:
Stood up sign-in / sign-up surfaces and brand geometry (violet / coral / tide). Hit a classic trap: auth pages looking generic until we forced Octivate lockup + theme tokens. Cleverly fixed by wiring CSS variables from theme.css into chrome and auth shells so every screen felt like one product. Blocker: confusing env vs local JSON user store — documented .env.example and kept secrets out of git. Story beat: judges should feel Caribbean decision-intelligence, not a template SaaS clone.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Tue_07_14.png

days.title: Landing narrative takes shape
days.body:
Built Why / How / Contact landing sections and mailing-list hooks. Issue: first viewport overcrowded with stats and cards. We ruthlessly simplified — brand first, one headline, one CTA, real visual anchor — matching our design rules. Agent suggested overbuilt layouts; I pushed back; we converged on a calmer Phase-1 landing. Also sketched public sample brief path so prospects can see product without dashboards.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Wed_07_15.png

days.title: Workspace theatre begins
days.body:
Projects, questions, and the eight-agent pipeline scaffolding came online. Blocker: orchestrator limits and mock vs live OpenRouter modes fighting each other. Fix: explicit runtime mode + operator limits store so demos stay predictable. Fun moment: first time the PSN pipeline stages lit up in the UI — felt like the product exhaled. Logged gaps for evidence manager + human review assistant next.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Thu_07_16.png

days.title: Sources registry + capture path
days.body:
Caribbean source packs and capture runner started to matter. CSV import was fussy (encodings, headers). We hardened parse + registry map and added artifact folders under data/local (gitignored). Halted briefly when a capture job stuck in `running` — later earned a Resume mode. Today we at least made import reproducible and operator-visible.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Fri_07_17.png

days.title: Operator console sketch
days.body:
Weekend push on the operator console: users, mail stubs, logs, moderation placeholders. Lesson: operator UI sprawls fast. Introduced modular panels and kept mail/inbox as a dedicated rail. Pair programming with the agent meant rapid UI scaffolding, then I pruned anything that smelled like fake dashboard chrome.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Sat_07_18.png

days.title: Stabilization + doctrine sync
days.body:
Synced protocol v0.2 agent charters/schemas into the repo and validated the developer doctrine brief was reachable. Quiet day of glue: TypeScript types, guard helpers, rate limits. No hero feature — on purpose. Reliability is an achievement when the week was scaffolding fireworks.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Sun_07_19.png

days.title: Briefs + export ambition
days.body:
Brief detail pages and export template store took center stage. Ambition: HTML/PDF/DOCX/PPTX from one tokenized template. Immediate issue: huge HTML bodies and base64 assets choking uploads. Mitigated with sanitize options, seed templates, and asset directories. Customer-facing promise crystallizing: evidence-backed briefs you can actually hand to a minister or board.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Mon_07_20.png

days.title: TLS edge + production serve
days.body:
Wired production edge (HTTP/HTTPS) and cert sync scripts. Windows cert paths were annoying; self-signed + sync scripts unblocked local `octivate.io` HTTPS. Halted when ports 80/443 collided with old node shells — learned the 4294967295 exit code is just Windows saying we killed a process. Clever fix: disciplined stop/start of start-app + serve:prod.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Tue_07_21.png

days.title: Mail SMTP local stack
days.body:
Stood up local SMTP submission (25/587) for operator outbound and password reset. Spam-flood crashes (exit 134) taught us to babysit the mailer. Still, end-to-end mail path existed: compose → nodemailer → local submitter → mailbox JSON. Not glamorous — foundational.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Wed_07_22.png

days.title: Pricing catalogue becomes real
days.body:
Free / Single brief ($15.99) / Team ($19.99/mo) catalogued in lib/billing with operator-editable store. Checkout modal shell + payment method icons. Debate: don’t promise cancel UX before accounts ship — we tempered Team copy. Pricing page now reads from the same source of truth the product will charge against.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Thu_07_23.png

days.title: Onboarding tutorial tour
days.body:
Workspace intro tour (6 steps) with accent art, kickers, and Lucide icons. Design language for later email cards was born here: mono eyebrow, title + accent fragment, short bullets. Agent overbuilt first draft; we cut to clear steps operators can replay from Workspace Tutorial.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Fri_07_24.png

days.title: Support threads + speech experiments
days.body:
Live support threads and speech dictation hooks. Tap-to-speak initially blocked on getUserMedia — fixed by starting SpeechRecognition without forcing mic preview first. Small UX win, big “this feels modern” energy for demos.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Sat_07_25.png

days.title: Source editor UX polish
days.body:
Per-source delete, autosave (no Save button), IconSelect, section tabs. Operator source capture panel gained clearer pending/running states. Theme toggles on marketing navbar for signed-in return-to-workspace. Product started feeling curated, not provisional.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Sun_07_26.png

days.title: HTML uploads + capture Resume
days.body:
Allowed .html/.htm in dropzone; TEXT_EXTS updated. Capture Resume mode recovers stuck `running` → `pending` with multi-wave drain — the clever fix for Friday’s ghost jobs. Operator panel shows Resume when pending > 0. Build/restart loop practiced until muscle memory.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Mon_07_27.png

days.title: Navbar auth CTAs + AI sliders
days.body:
Signed-in marketing chrome: hide Sign in / Request Demo; show Return to workspace (+ Operator dashboard). AI module sliders drag from header handle only — stopped accidental layout chaos. Mobile sheet theme-aware. Feels like a real SaaS shell.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Tue_07_28.png

days.title: Export pipeline hardening
days.body:
Deep work on export pipeline (prepare → render → pdf/docx/pptx). Seed Octivate brief template tokenized. Occasional Turbopack NFT warnings from data/local breadth — noted, didn’t block ship. Briefs became presentable artifacts, not just JSON.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Wed_07_29.png

days.title: Supabase ops + cost tracking
days.body:
Ops migrations for costs/config; operator costs panel. When local JSON wasn’t enough for multi-operator truth, Supabase admin paths helped. Kept fallbacks so demos never hard-fail offline.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Thu_07_30.png

days.title: Mail DNS / DKIM tooling
days.body:
Scripts for DKIM generation and Cloudflare mail DNS. External delivery still depends on MX/SPF alignment — we surface honest SMTP warnings instead of fake green checks. Integrity over theatre.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Fri_07_31.png

days.title: Mail templates seed + invite copy
days.body:
Seeded mail-templates.json (announce/invite/newsletter/update). Invite copy aimed at demos: live brief, evidence trail, product itself. Prepared the narrative we’d later put into a cinematic HTML shell.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Sat_08_01.png

days.title: Breathing room + QA
days.body:
Regression day: health checks, auth flows, pricing hrefs for guests (/signup not /dashboard). Cleared confusing footer deep-links. Sunday discipline: less new surface area, more trust.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Sun_08_02.png

days.title: Email shell redesign begins
days.body:
Redesigned shared HTML email after a cinematic table reference — Octivate palette (violet→coral→tide), embedded lockup, landing-inspired nav/footer. Initial logo asset was white-boxed and portrait; we caught it. Forgot-password wired through the same generator with structured greeting/bullets/expiry.

Product surfaces exercised today (public): Landing hero, Pricing, Sample brief, Sign up, Sign in, Support — captured for the octivate.io archive so judges can see the marketing shell live.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Mon_08_03.png

days.title: Invite-grade mail + GitHub private repo
days.body:
Transparent lockup, tutorial-style feature cards, live pricing cards from readBillingPlans ($0 / $15.99 / $19.99). Default send intent = platform invite. Also installed Git + gh, authenticated, pushed private repo https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate and took a 5.3GB full Desktop backup (data + .env, no node_modules). Plot twist: PAT pasted in chat — we rotated guidance. Human + machine shipping like a pit crew.

Workspace surfaces verified signed-in as Shemuel: Dashboard overview, Projects, Briefs, Sources, Packs, Monitors, Stakeholders, Usage, Account — proof the decision-intelligence rails load on octivate.io.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Tue_08_04.png

days.title: Mail WIP gate + Logbook automation
days.body:
Added blurred Work-in-progress overlay on operator compose/send (flag in lib/mail/feature-flags.ts) so outbound mail can’t be half-launched mid-polish. Inbox/list still usable. Built Future Caribbean logbook automation from the Desktop octivate.io archive index.html (dynamic parse → paste → Save entry), plus a corrected date-synced resync after finding scrambled/empty days. Operator console + project detail captured. Date-synced resync completed after scrambled/empty days were detected.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Wed_08_05.png

days.title: Operator Logbook publisher — one-button Future Caribbean sync
days.body:
Shipped a professional, operator-only Future Caribbean Logbook publisher on the Octivate Operator → Operations dashboard. One clear action button runs: (1) inventory check of what is already on os.futurecaribbean.com versus our planned day entries, (2) GitHub evidence upload of sequential screenshots under docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots, (3) publish/fill any unaccounted days including today, with live step labels + progress bar naming the destination site. Past entries now carry direct GitHub screenshot URLs. Built for Shemuel / Open Track judges — certainty over theatre.

Evidence screenshot: https://github.com/CCNAHLHQ/octivate/blob/main/docs/future-caribbean-logbook/screenshots/Thu_08_06.png
